goals.easy:
Goal: Build a stable bridge across the gap with continuous wheel paths on both sides. Release the bridge pieces, then press and release the button and let the car drive across to the opposite bank.

TASK RECIPE:
# Bridge Construction and Car Crossing — Easy

## Capability dimension
Select and assemble a functional structure, then verify its operation.

## Description
Eight pieces, all needed; no spares. Carry each piece in a real finger grasp, lifted over 35 mm; each must end seated within 12 mm of its place, supported by the pieces below. After releasing the bridge, press the start button once and release it, then keep both arms out of the button area and the car lane. The car starts when the lane is clear and must reach the opposite bank without leaving the lane, falling or tipping.

## Scoring
100: Full success — all task requirements are satisfied.
Otherwise: 20 × k / 10 points (always below 20). Steps: the 8 bridge pieces in place, lower layers first, one valid button press after the bridge is complete, then the car reaching the opposite bank. k counts the required steps completed consecutively from the start, before the first error.
